The payment processing took a while, but once they provided a tracking number, I received an email notifying me that my package was on its way. The shipping was really fast and my items arrived ahead of schedule. My only complaint is that the parts were all put in one bag without any labels. Highly recommend, and will buy from again if I need Suzuki dirt bike or arctic cat snowmobile parts.
